why: The estate's one skill layer. Every pack here is installed into a runtime's skills directory only after its files hash to what this file says, and only into one of the four allowlisted runtime roots. The pack contents are the capability; this file is the contract.

packs.title: Anthropic's agent cookbook -- prompts, review and research patterns
packs.capability: Worked patterns for building agents: a code-reviewer agent, a research lead and subagent pair, and a cookbook audit that grades a prompt against a style guide.

packs.title: Awesome DESIGN.md -- brand design specs as code
packs.capability: Read and write DESIGN.md: the file that states a brand's colours, type, spacing, motion and components so an agent builds the brand instead of a generic page.

packs.title: Canvas UI -- canvas and WebGL interface primitives
packs.capability: Canvas/WebGL UI primitives for interfaces that cannot be DOM: 3D scenes, shaders, and interactive canvases inside a product.

packs.title: Google DESIGN.md -- the specification and its linter
packs.capability: The DESIGN.md specification itself, with worked examples and the linter that checks one, so a brand spec is a checkable artifact rather than prose.

packs.title: Design engineering skills -- craft, motion and native feel
packs.capability: Design-engineering craft: animation vocabulary and performance, native-feeling mobile UI, Apple design language, and the breaking-the-template-look rules.

packs.title: Estate architecture -- how a decision gets written down
packs.capability: Architecture inside the estate: one of each layer, a spec before the build, a decision record for every fork, and the gates that prove the shape is right.

packs.title: Estate research -- how an agent finds out
packs.capability: Research inside the estate: the harvest intent for capability, search-text and explore for the corpus, the knowledge graph for what is already known, and the rule that a claim needs a source.

packs.title: Evaluation methodology -- rubrics, scoring and improving a score
packs.capability: How to grade an agent or a model against a rubric, how to write that rubric, and what to do when the score is wrong: the methodology, the rubric reference and the score-improvement loop.

packs.title: GSAP skills -- motion that runs at 60fps
packs.capability: GSAP used correctly: core tweens and timelines, ScrollTrigger, plugins, React integration, and the performance rules that keep it smooth.

packs.title: Hallmark -- web design craft, macrostructures and gates
packs.capability: The anatomy of a good page: macrostructures, layout, type, flow, interaction states, and the gates a design must pass before it ships.

packs.title: Impeccable -- the design language a harness should speak
packs.capability: A craft floor for an agent: audit, critique, refine and document a design, with the bar written down before the work starts.

packs.title: Kubernetes hardening checklist -- the cluster's own security baseline
packs.capability: The upstream Kubernetes security checklist and pod security standards: the baseline the estate's cluster is held to, so an agent reviews a manifest against the standard rather than against memory.

packs.title: Open Design -- the design workspace skill set
packs.capability: The working skills of a design workspace: brand kit, design brief, creative direction, review, colour, copy.

packs.title: React Bits -- animated React components you can drop in
packs.capability: Pick and adapt animated React components (text, backgrounds, buttons, containers) instead of writing a bespoke animation from scratch.

packs.title: Scroll World -- a brand as a scrollable 3D world
packs.capability: Turn a brand into a scroll-scrubbed 3D world landing page, with the scrub engine and the prompts that produce it.

packs.title: Security engineering -- threat modelling, requirements, SAST configuration
packs.capability: Threat modelling as a repeatable craft: attack trees, STRIDE analysis, security requirements extracted from the design, SAST configuration, and a mitigation map that ties each threat to its control.

packs.title: Spec-Driven Development -- specify, plan, task, implement, verify
packs.capability: GitHub's spec-driven method: a specification template, a plan template, a task breakdown, a checklist generator and the commands that drive them, so an agent works from an agreed spec instead of an impression.

packs.title: Superpowers -- plan first, test first, subagent-driven development
packs.capability: The staff engineer's daily loop, as skills: brainstorm the approach, write the plan, execute it in steps, drive it with tests, and review the result before it is called done.

packs.title: Taste -- critique a design against real references
packs.capability: Critique a screen the way a designer does, against a reference library of real work, with the tells named.

packs.title: Playwright skills -- drive the real page, read the trace, prove the fix
packs.capability: Proving a UI change on the real page: drive it with Playwright, read the trace, triage a failure, and read the test results - so a UI claim is a screenshot or a trace, never a description.

packs.title: UI/UX Pro Max -- design system, tokens, brand, banners
packs.capability: Turn a request into a token-backed design system: primitive and semantic tokens, a component spec, a brand kit, and a banner that matches the brand.
